'''Shadow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[operative]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Loyal to [[Darth Vowrawn]] of the [[Dark Council]], Shadow worked with the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]] to [[Mission to Corellia (Emperor's Wrath)|stop]] [[Darth Baras]]'s assassination attempts on his master during the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Shadow has learned that an agent of Baras was embedded in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] itself, directing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who posed a threat to Baras, but was unable to report on his name. When Shadow was pinned down by the enemy artillery, Vowrawn send Wrath to rescue him and Shadow was able to provide him with the location at which a group of Jedi, including the spy, had gathered. The Wrath proceeded to the location and successfully exposed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Injaye]] as Baras' spy.
